title: What If Google Maps Could Talk?

lines.text: What if Google Maps could actually talk?
lines.why: phone buzzes, the assistant pops out of the screen, owner recoils

lines.text: Oh, finally. We need to talk.
lines.why: comedic beat; owner pockets the phone

lines.text: Why do customers keep calling when we're closed?
Because your profile says you're open on Sundays.
lines.why: owner reads the card; calendar turns to Sunday

lines.text: We stopped working Sundays last year!
Your opening hours are a historical documentary.
Your main category says General Contractor. You mostly repair roofs. Is that really your best description?
I thought you'd figure it out!
I'm a map, not your unpaid office manager.
lines.why: paperwork slides across to the owner

lines.text: Your Google Business Profile should accurately describe what you do and when you're available.
Review your category, business hours, services, and contact details.
Accurate information helps customers make decisions. It doesn't automatically guarantee top rankings.
No. You were ignoring your profile.
